//: Editor metadata ONLY — not a build step, and nothing in the game reads it.
The app still ships as plain classic <script> tags with no bundler (see
CLAUDE.md). This exists so an IDE can resolve the globals those scripts
share (G, ROOMS, NPCS, _say, _tick, …) ACROSS files, which is the one real
daily cost of the unbundled layout.
checkJs is deliberately OFF. Turning it on over ~40k lines with no
annotations reports thousands of errors on day one and helps nobody; the
value here is intellisense and go-to-definition, not a type gate. Flip it
per-file with // @ts-check when a file is worth the pass.
moduleDetection 'legacy' is load-bearing: package.json sets type:module (so
node --test reads the ESM tests), which would otherwise make the language
server treat these script files as modules and hide every shared global
from every other file — the exact thing this config exists to fix.
